After the rest i.e. all those verbs not falling under any one of the previous provisions, the terminations of the परस्मैपद are used, in marking the agent i.e. in the active voice.

Terms: परस्मैपद

The rest of the words that end in short इ and उ are घि with the exception of the word सखि।

Terms:

In the other cases, viz. where 'thou' or 'I' are not the attendant words in agreement with the verb, there is the verbal termination called the Lowest (3rd person).

Terms:

The remaining compound is called बहुव्रीही।

Terms: समास-तत्-पुरुष-विभक्ति-3-7

In all the cases when 'wonder' is implied by word other than यच्च and यत्र , the affix लृट् (I Future) is used after a root, except when the word यदि is used.

Terms: लृट्

The affixes taught hereafter have senses other than those mentioned above.

Terms: शेष

After all other बहुव्रीहि समास not covered by the foregoing rules, may optionally be added the affix कप्‌।

Terms: कप्‌

In the छन्दस् , the elision of the case-ending इ (शि) of the nominative and accusative plural neuter, is optional.

Terms: विभक्ति-8

An आर्धधातुक affix beginning with a स् (except सिच् the characteristic of s-Aorist) may optionally take the इट् augment after the verbs 1. कृत् (तुदादिगणः (6th Conjugation) and रुधादिगणः (7th Conjugation) 2. चृत् - तुदादिगणः (6th Conjugation) 3. छृद् - रुधादिगणः (7th Conjugation) 4. तृद् -- तुदादिगणः (6th Conjugation) and 5. नृत् -- दिवादिगणः (4th Conjugation).

Terms: इट् augment

In the remaining cases where (आ or य is not substituted) there is elision of the final युष्मद् and अस्मद्।

Terms: सर्वनाम युष्मद्- अस्मद्

The finite verb optionally retains its accent in connection with अहो in the remaining cases (i.e. where it does not mean 'praise').

Terms: Accent

When the above mentioned particles आहो and उताहो do not immediately precede the verb, the verb may optionally retain its accent.

Terms: Accent

In the remaining verbs, optionally the न of नि is replaced by ण , when it is preceded by an उपसर्ग competent to cause the change; provided that, in the original enunciation, the verb has not an initial क or ख , nor ends with ष।

Terms: सन्धि-हल्-धातु-उपसर्ग
